newsitem.title: USA: Calcomp sees gross margins under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Calcomp sees gross margins under pressure.

text.p: CalComp Technology Inc Wednesday said gross margins are likely to remain under pressure over the near term.

"We are continuing to explore additional avenues to improve our gross margins and reduce our cost structure," CalComp said. "Good progress is being made preparing for the launch in the second half of 1997 of an entirely new line of large format digital imaging products based on a proprietary new inkjet technology acquired late last year. Early reception to our proprietary Crystaljet inkjet technology at recent industry conferences has been excellent."

CalComp is a supplier of computer graphics peripheral products, including large format LED direct and dry imaging, vector and inkjet plotters and printers, sign cutters, digitizers and large format scanners.
